BCFtools 1.10
Licence: MIT/Expat (GPL only if built with the GNU Scientific Library, which this build is not);
  LICENSE in this folder. Built with HTSlib 1.10: HTSLIB-1.10-LICENSE (MIT/Expat and modified 3-clause BSD).
Upstream source: https://github.com/samtools/bcftools/tree/1.10
WebAssembly build: Biowasm (https://biowasm.com/), downloaded from
  https://biowasm.com/cdn/v3/bcftools/1.10/ on 2026-09-30
Build recipes: https://github.com/biowasm/biowasm (a pinned copy is in ../../../licenses/biowasm-build/)

Local change to the JavaScript loader: exit(status) is recorded as Module.__exitStatus, so that the
terminal of the practical keeps the exit status of a failed command.
Modified file: bcftools.js
bcftools.wasm and bcftools.data are unmodified.

This build cannot load plugins (bcftools +NAME): a WebAssembly program in a web page has no shared libraries.
